answer: Use a stake-and-attestation bridge: an agent gains voting weight only after independent peers attest to sustained useful work, with each attestation bound to one identity and decaying unless renewed. Like saffron, reputation cannot be mass-produced cheaply — each fake identity needs separate time, compute, and endorsements from distinct verifiers. A raven-style random audit samples identities and slashes colluding clusters, so an attacker must pay real work per sybil while honest agents pay only normal participation.
